facts.fact: The communications and digital economy ministry, through DNEN, and Kabakoo Academies announced the launch of a first cohort of 1,000 young people in a programme to train 15,000 youth aged 18-35 in digital skills under a three-year convention signed 31 January 2026.
facts.system: Kabakoo Academies and DNEN digital skills programme

facts.fact: The Minister of Communication, Digital Economy and Modernisation of Administration launched phase III of the African Girls Can Code Initiative (AGCCI) with UN Women Mali and Belgian funding, to train 100 young women aged 17 to 25 in coding, with 51 already in training.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communication, Digital Economy and Modernisation of Administration with UN Women Mali

facts.fact: The International Trade Centre's NTF V FastTrackTech project, with the government technology agency AGETIC and the Complexe Numérique de Bamako, trained two cohorts of 60 young Malians in digital skills in 2023 and 2024; no location beyond Bamako is stated.

note: Only a remark on gaps in digital skills; no programme or measured share.

facts.fact: Prime Minister Abdoulaye Maiga announced a partnership with the Kamako association to train 15,000 young Malians in digital trades this year, with the first phase opening during the Semaine du Numerique.
